messages:
simon-peopleops: Quick question  Paola's candidate (UK remote) needs band5->band6 uplift and benefits effective 2026-07-06 (start). Payroll enrollment earliest 2026-07-20. Manager asking for benefits to start on day one to avoid losing candidate. Thoughts?

paola-hiring: Candidate accepted verbally; start date is firm 07/06. Manager says the hire is mission-critical. They want band6 to match counteroffer.

frank-finance: Short flag: we can backdate benefits and payroll enrollments but need CFO approval + documented exception. One-time employer NI adjustment is small. Need uplift cost estimate.

zoe-talent: If benefits postpone, candidate might rescind. We can offer vendor-funded interim health from day one while payroll catches up, but need sign-off from Finance and People Ops.

rita-legal: Legal ok with retroactive enrollment if the signed offer shows effective 07/06 and we record the exception. Recommend cap retro at 14 days and a clear audit note.

simon-peopleops: Proposed workflow: 1) Approve provisional band6 pending CFO confirmation. 2) Approve benefits retro to start date up to 14 days. 3) If payroll delay >7 days, People Ops to arrange vendor interim coverage. Approve?

frank-finance: OK conditional on CFO. I'll compute uplift delta and ping Maria.

hr-bot: Tasks created: "calc-uplift-cost" -> @frank-finance (due 2026-06-30); "issue-updated-offer" -> @simon-peopleops (due 2026-07-01).

maria-cfo: (via DM) I've reviewed the brief. Approve band6 uplift and benefits retro up to 14 days. Finance to absorb payroll adj.

frank-finance: CFO approved. Final decision: band6 uplift confirmed, benefits enrollment backdated to 07/06 (max 14 days). People Ops to issue corrected offer and request payroll backdate.

simon-peopleops: Updated offer sent and exception logged (EXC-2026-113). Candidate signed at 14:05. HR-bot triggered manual enrollment and payroll note. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
